Name: Italian Chicken Marinade
Description: This Italian dressing chicken marinade is a super simple but delicious way to add flavor before grilling.

Name: Chicken Marsala
Description: Chicken Marsala is an Italian-style recipe for tender pan-fried chicken breasts in a sweet Marsala wine and mushroom sauce. It's super quick and easy to make for a weeknight dinner AND sophisticated enough for company.

Name: Hearty Vegetable Lasagna
Description: This hearty, vegetable lasagna is the only lasagna my husband will eat. We love it! Hope you all enjoy it as much as we do.

Name: Cheesy Vegetable Lasagna
Description: A rich, cheesy lasagna loaded with vegetables. You could also omit all veggies except broccoli for a broccoli lasagna.

Name: Pasta Salad
Description: This pasta salad recipe was given to me by a dear friend many years ago, and I've been making it ever since! It's great for barbecues.

Name: Italian Wedding Soup
Description: This lovely Italian wedding soup recipe combines flavorful meatballs with sliced escarole, orzo pasta, and finely chopped carrot. Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley and extra Parmesan cheese.

Name: Chicken Teriyaki Noodles
Description: Silky noodles tossed with tender chicken in a glossy sweet-savoury teriyaki sauce, finished with sesame and spring onion.

Name: Chicken Tikka Masala
Description: Charred chicken tikka simmered in a creamy spiced tomato gravy. Rich, warming and best served with rice or naan.

Name: Congee
Description: A comforting slow-simmered rice porridge, gently seasoned and topped to taste. Light, soothing and perfect any time of day.

Name: Creamy Gochujang Tortellini
Description: Cheese-filled tortellini in a velvety gochujang cream sauce - a little sweet, a little spicy, completely addictive.

Name: Crispy Vegetable Pakoras
Description: Golden, crunchy vegetable fritters in a spiced chickpea batter. Served hot with chutney on the side.

Name: Haluski Noodles
Description: Buttery pan-fried noodles with sweet caramelised cabbage and onion - simple, homely comfort food.

Name: Tiramisu
Description: The classic Italian dessert - espresso-soaked ladyfingers layered with airy mascarpone cream and a dusting of cocoa.

Name: Cheesecake
Description: Rich, dense and impossibly creamy baked cheesecake on a buttery biscuit base. A slice of pure comfort.

Name: Berry Tart
Description: A crisp pastry shell filled with silky vanilla custard and crowned with fresh glazed berries.

Name: Cherry Danish
Description: Flaky, buttery layers of pastry with a sweet cheese centre and a spoonful of cherry compote.
